title: Karl-Witthalm-Straße, Munich
description:
Spacious and light-flooded living pleasure awaits you in this impressive first-time occupancy! With its long south-facing window front, the largest and brightest room in the flat not only offers a great view and plenty of light, but also a pleasant living atmosphere. The entire flat has been completely refurbished and boasts state-of-the-art amenities. With a total of four shared rooms and two bathrooms, it offers an ideal shared layout and the opportunity to spend evenings together in the cooking/dining area or on the communal balcony.

The room is the most spacious in the shared flat at a good 20 square metres and is rented fully furnished with a bed, mattress with topper, wardrobe, armchair, small table, desk, desk chair and a desk lamp and other small details. Of course, you can also bring your own furniture if you wish.

FLAT FURNISHINGS:
- Oak parquet flooring throughout the flat
- Bathroom with bathtub, shower room with rain shower in light grey fine stone
- Electric underfloor heating in both bathrooms
- LAN cabling and multimedia in all rooms
- Electric roller shutters
- Dimmable and controllable recessed LED spotlights in the hallway and kitchen

ROOM SIZES:
- Room 1 (this advert): 20sqm

- Room 2: 15,5sqm
- Room 3: 8,5sqm
- Room 4: 11sqm
- Common area: 28,5sqm



**LOCATION**
The connection to public transport is excellent. Underground, bus and tram stops are just a few minutes' walk away, allowing for smooth and stress-free mobility within the city. At the same time, shopping facilities, restaurants, cafés and other services are within easy walking distance, making everyday life particularly convenient.

UNIVERSITIES (underground connection):
- Haderner Stern - LMU (Campus Großhadern): 3min (without change)
- Haderner Stern - LMU Centre (University): 16min (without change)
- Haderner Stern - TUM (Campus Königsplatz): 19min (1x change)
- Haderner Stern - TUM (Campus Garching Research Centre): 39min (without change)

Due to the proximity to the LMU, students in the shared flat have the luxury of being able to reach their campus by bike in a short time (6 min to Campus Großhadern). This not only saves time and money for the daily commute, but also enables a better work-life balance.

CITY LIFE (bars, shopping, English Garden):

- min. 6 months 
- limited to a maximum of 3 years, but can be optionally extended under certain circumstances 

INCLUDED IN RENT:
- actual basic rent
- all operating costs

- electricity, internet connection

title: Scapinellistraße, Munich
description:
The bright flat comprises 4 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, 1 guest WC, a kitchen, a balcony and the possibility to rent a parking space.
